title: 'We'll carry on': Expect heavy traffic on NLEX for Nov. 14 MCR concert
summary: Traffic is expected to be heavy around the Philippine Arena in Bulacan for the local leg of the My Chemical Romance Southeast Asia 2026 Tour on Saturday, November 14, tollway operator NLEX Corp. said.
